>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Exchanges an Apple identity token (from the native Sign in with Apple
sheet) for a Famlin session token. Needs no server-side configuration —
Apple's issuer and keys are fixed and the token's audience is the
client app's bundle identifier — so it is available on every
deployment. Self-hosters distributing their own iOS build add its
bundle identifier to the `appleBundleIds` server setting.

Account provisioning follows the same rules as any other login: a new
account is only created when the email is on the server's allow-list
or a valid invite token covers the signup. Apple private-relay
addresses will practically always need an invite.

Rate-limited to 10 attempts per 15 minutes per IP.
